companyDomain.title: Company domain
companyDomain.description: The company to analyze, as a bare domain. Its competitors are identified automatically from the model's knowledge of the market, or supplied via the "competitors" input.

maxCompetitors.title: Maximum competitors
maxCompetitors.description: How many competitors to read. The competitor set is named most-direct-first, so a lower number keeps the closest competitors and drops the rest. Changing this makes the next run a fresh baseline rather than a NEW/SEEN diff.

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.description: Optional. Explicit competitor domains, as bare domains such as "rival.com". When set, these are used instead of asking the model to name competitors. Changing this list makes the next run a fresh baseline rather than a NEW/SEEN diff, because it changes what the run looks at.
